metadata.title: $L$-Space Knots in $\mathfrak{sl}_{n}$-like Knot Floer Homology
metadata.abstract: It has been of particular interest in recent years to relate categorifications of quantum knot invariants like the Jones polynomial to Floer-theoretic invariants like knot Floer homology using spectral sequences. In pursuit of Rasmussen's conjecture, Dowlin constructed a family of invariants with properties like those of Khovanov and Rozansky's $\mathfrak{sl}_n$-homology theories. In this paper, we explore these invariants for $L$-space knots and thin knots. In particular, for $n\geq 2$ the invariants of thin knots can be computed from a change of coefficients from the minus flavor of knot Floer homology, and the same holds for an $L$-space knot exactly when an explicit condition relating $n$ to its Alexander polynomial is satisfied.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 特殊结的 sl_n 类 Floer 不变量计算
analysis.workSummary: 研究 Dowlin 构造的 sl_n 类结 Floer 不变量在 thin knots 和 L-space knots 上的计算。对 n≥2，thin knots 的该不变量可由 minus 版本结 Floer 同调作系数变换得到；对 L-space knots，同一计算方式成立当且仅当 n 与 Alexander 多项式满足一个显式条件。
techniques: 结 Floer 同调的系数变换
analysis.breakthrough: 给出两类结上的可操作计算法，并在 L-space 情形刻画适用边界。
analysis.limitations: 背景中的 Rasmussen 猜想和谱序列联系不是本文已完全解决的结论；L-space 结不是对全部 n 无条件成立，需保留显式判据。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
